# Stouls Studio

> Interior architecture studio in Paris run by Margaux Stouls. For buyers based in the United States and Canada: apartment sourcing, design, renovation management and furnishing, for a rental investment or a pied-à-terre.

- [Buy and renovate an apartment in Paris | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/): Margaux Stouls, interior architect in Paris, finds your apartment, draws the plans, runs the renovation and furnishes it while you stay in the US or Canada. Rental investment or pied-à-terre.
- [Buying an apartment in Paris from abroad | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/apartment-sourcing-paris/): Looking at apartments for sale in Paris from the US or Canada? An interior architect visits them for you and prices the renovation before you make an offer.
- [Paris apartment renovation, managed for you | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/paris-apartment-renovation/): Plans, building approvals, contractors, site visits and furnishing for your Paris apartment, run by interior architect Margaux Stouls and reported to you in English.
- [A pied-à-terre in Paris, found and renovated | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/paris-pied-a-terre/): Your own apartment in Paris, found, renovated and furnished by an interior architect while you are at home. Arrive to a finished place.
- [English-speaking interior architect in Paris | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/about/): Margaux Stouls founded Stouls Studio in Paris in 2019. She designs and manages apartment renovations, and works with owners based in North America.
- [Portfolio of interior architect Margaux Stouls | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/): Nine projects by Stouls Studio in Paris and beyond: main residences, rental apartments and second homes, plus custom furniture, 3D visualisations and technical drawings.
- [Apartment, Paris 9th | Stouls Studio portfolio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/apartment-paris-9/): An apartment redesigned around the timber posts that hold up the building. Main residence, Paris, 9th arrondissement. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Apartment with mezzanine, Montparnasse | Stouls Studio portfolio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/mezzanine-apartment-montparnasse/): A double-height room turned into a complete apartment, with the bed on a mezzanine. Rental property, Paris, Montparnasse. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Top-floor studio | Stouls Studio portfolio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/top-floor-studio/): A studio under the roof, laid out as a real one-room home for a tenant who stays for months. Rental property, Paris. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Apartment, Paris 18th | Stouls Studio portfolio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/apartment-paris-18/): A small apartment shown twice: as it was drawn in three dimensions, and as it was built. Main residence, Paris, 18th arrondissement. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Apartment, Levallois-Perret | Stouls Studio portfolio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/apartment-levallois/): An apartment where almost every wall carries something built for it. Main residence, Levallois-Perret, west of Paris. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Apartment, Montmartre | Stouls Studio portfolio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/apartment-montmartre/): A kitchen that became the dining room, in walnut and oak with glazed tile. Main residence, Paris, 18th arrondissement. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Bedroom and library joinery | Stouls Studio portfolio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/bedroom-and-library-joinery/): Three pieces of joinery drawn for one apartment and made by cabinetmakers. Custom-made furniture, Paris region. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Country house | Stouls Studio portfolio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/country-house/): A house used for part of the year, where colour does most of the work. Second home, France. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [House on Sifnos | Stouls Studio portfolio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/house-sifnos/): A whitewashed house on a Greek island, designed for owners who live elsewhere. Second home, Sifnos, Greece. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Paris rental investment: what is allowed | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/paris-rental-investment/): Short tourist lets of a second home are all but closed in Paris. What still works, the energy-rating rules, and how an interior architect sources and builds a rental apartment for you.
- [Can Americans buy an apartment in Paris? | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/guide/buying-renovating-paris-apartment/): The purchase steps, the costs on top of the price, building approvals, energy ratings, rental rules and taxes to ask your adviser about, each with its official source.
- [Paris property glossary in plain English | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/): Plain-English definitions of the French words in a Paris apartment purchase and renovation: notaire, compromis, copropriété, syndic, DPE, loi Carrez, chambre de bonne, pied-à-terre.
- [What is a pied-à-terre? Meaning and pronunciation | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/pied-a-terre/): A pied-à-terre is a small second home in a city, kept for short stays. Meaning, pronunciation, plural, and what owning one in Paris involves.
- [What is a Haussmann apartment? | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/haussmann-apartment/): A Haussmann (Haussmannian) apartment is in one of the cut-stone buildings from the rebuilding of Paris, 1853 to 1870. How to recognise one, its layout, and what a renovation changes.
- [What is a chambre de bonne? | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/chambre-de-bonne/): A chambre de bonne is a former servant's room under the roof of a Paris building, usually 6 to 12 m². What it is, the legal minimum size to rent one, and what can be done with it.
- [Copropriété and syndic explained | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/copropriete-syndic/): A copropriété is a building owned in shares by its apartment owners. The syndic is the manager they appoint. What each does, what you pay, and what they decide about your renovation.
- [Paris apartment renovation cost per m² | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/paris-apartment-renovation-cost/): What Paris firms publish for renovation cost per m², from a refresh to a full premium renovation, why two apartments of the same size differ, and the costs on top of the contractor's quote.
- [Buying an apartment in Paris from Canada | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/canadian-buyers-paris/): Stouls Studio's first overseas clients were Canadian. How a Canadian buyer finds, buys, renovates and furnishes a Paris apartment without being on site, in English or French.
- [Legal notice and privacy | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/legal/): Who publishes stoulsstudio.com: company name, registration, registered office, publication director, host, and how personal data is handled.
